messages:
sara_support: Customer hit a production failure parsing JSON-mode output. They get a JSONDecodeError when consuming streaming chunks. Error started after a large multi-line pasted prompt. 

sara_support: Repro summary from customer: model in structured mode returned an object but a string field contains a broken surrogate and a lone backslash at chunk boundary. Parser fails. They included request_id: req_0b9f3a and trace_id: trace-9a7c.

sara_support: Minimal repro curl they provided:
```
curl -sS -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"rwd-2b","mode":"json","input":"paste-with-emoji-and-windows-crlf"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
```

sara_support: Snippet of returned stream (customer pasted):
```
{"choices":[{"value":{"text":"Line1
Line2 �"},"cursor":1}]}
```

sara_support: Notice the broken surrogate `�` and also the output ended with a single backslash in another chunk for them earlier (they see `...\` at chunk end).

alex_eng-runtime: :eyes: can you paste the full raw stream with request_id? need to see chunk boundaries and any CRLF normalization. streaming can split surrogate pairs if boundary falls between halves.

sara_support: Pasting raw stream in case it helps:
```
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"text":"Line1
"}}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"text":"Line2 �"}}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"text":"�"}}]}

data: [DONE]
```

alex_eng-runtime: OK this shows exactly the surrogate split: `�` then `�`. When clients directly concatenate chunks the result should be valid, but some JSON-mode serializers escape halves differently which can confuse downstream JSON parsers if streams are re-chunked. Also the CRLF `
` is literally present which some libs treat specially.

jon_sre: Any error spikes or increased latency/requests from that customer? they mentioned retries and bump in token usage / billing concern.

sara_support: They reported ~3 retries inside their client parsing loop, extra ~200 tokens billed. Asking for billing adjustment if we confirm it's our output fragmentation. Ticket CS-7896 opened.

maria_engineering: Short-term mitigation: in the streaming serializer we should ensure we emit full unicode escapes atomically for JSON-mode, or add a flag to force surrogate pair preservation across chunk boundaries. For immediate customer workaround: set `mode: text` or post-process the stream to join delta chunks before feeding to JSON parser. Also `structured:false` avoids forced JSON escaping.

alex_eng-runtime: Action items:
- eng-runtime to add atomic-escape fix for JSON-mode streams (assign to me).
- support to offer the customer a temporary credits/billing adjustment (CS to decide).
- add an integration test that simulates surrogate pairs & CRLF and verifies assembled JSON parses.

alex_eng-runtime: Can you share stack traces / parser error text the customer saw? e.g., `JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at` or similar. That helps pinpoint where downstream parser failed.

sara_support: They sent this Python traceback snippet:
```
json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 45 (char 44)
```

maria_engineering: That matches split-escape symptoms. We'll prioritize a patch. Tentative ETA 2 business days for a runtime change; will push a canary.

jon_sre: Please include metrics alert to detect spike in JSON-mode parse failures (count parsing errors correlated with request_id/trace). Also capture the `stream_chunk_index` in logs to help root cause.

alex_eng-runtime: I'll create a short repro harness that streams the two halves as separate messages and feeds a naive JSON joiner to ensure we test typical client behavior.

sara_support: Noted. Customer wants an interim config change we can suggest — I'll propose `structured: false` + client-side join of deltas, and offer a one-time credit pending our fix.

deploy-bot: Deployed patch branch `fix/jsonstream-atomic-escapes` to staging at 2024-05-17T16:22:10Z

alex_eng-runtime: Thanks @deploy-bot. I'll run the regression tests. Will update CS-7896 with PR link and staging logs.

sara_support: Thanks team. I'll keep customer updated and close the loop after patch verification. :thumbsup:
